title: Dispatch: exact-token dice conservation gate (attempt 1)
description:
Works defect bead eshyra-2n3n (read it first: full analysis with file/line refs and measured blast radius). Parent spec: eshyra-f0nz (acceptance criterion 3). This touches an SRD gate test: read `docs/importer-fix-protocol.md` BEFORE changing anything and follow it.

Branch/worktree: this bead's id, cut from eshyra-f0nz.

## Code survey (verified 2026-07-19)

- `packages/core/test/srdGeneratedPack.test.ts`: `diceFamily` (line ~956) strips `[+-].*`; the forward gate (~1094-1104) and reverse gate (~1112-1121) accept family-only matches; `mechanicsTokens` pools parent + all variant mechanics into one item-wide set. Whole-record accept lists: `FORWARD_NUMERIC_CONSERVATION_ACCEPTS` / `REVERSE_NUMERIC_CONSERVATION_ACCEPTS` (~1064-1080).
- Measured against the committed pack (2026-07-19): exact-token matching leaves exactly 3 family-only survivors — `magic-item:robe-of-useful-items` forward `4d4` vs mechanics `4d4+12` AND reverse `4d4+12` vs prose `4d4`; `magic-item:staff-of-striking` forward `1d6` vs mechanics `1d6+4`.

## Required behavior change

1. Remove the `diceFamily` tolerance: conservation requires exact normalized dice tokens in both directions.
2. Add a token-scoped exception mechanism: exceptions keyed by record key + direction + exact token, each carrying a non-empty rationale string, asserted exhaustively at the bottom of the test the same way the whole-record accept lists are (so a stale exception fails the gate). Keep the existing whole-record accepts for their current documented cases.
3. Adjudicate the 3 survivors against the SRD source text (the pack's description fields carry it; the audit inventory under docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/ has the reviewed mechanics decisions):
   - Robe of Useful Items: SRD gives the robe two of each of six fixed patches (=12) plus 4d4 additional patches; if mechanics' `4d4+12` is that reviewed synthesized total, record BOTH directions as scoped exceptions with that rationale.
   - Staff of Striking: find where `1d6+4` comes from in the record's mechanics and check it against the SRD clause. If it is a correct reviewed representation, scoped exception with rationale; if it is an importer artifact, DO NOT add an exception — fix per docs/importer-fix-protocol.md (importer/curated-spec side), and if that is out of scope for this dispatch, file a follow-up bead with `bd create` and leave the gate red is NOT acceptable — in that case stop and report in your completion notes instead of committing a weakened gate.
4. Add a tamper test in the same style as the existing negative tests: a synthetic record whose mechanics drop a prose modifier (e.g. prose `1d6+5`, mechanics `1d6`) must produce a finding under the new exact matching (this is the regression the old family match hid).
5. Do NOT regenerate the pack; this dispatch changes only the gate test (and exceptions). Per-variant/per-clause scoping of token pooling: capture as a follow-up bead if you confirm it matters; do not implement here.

## Verification

`npm ci` first, then `npm run verify:worktree` from this worktree. Do not weaken any expectation without the source-backed rationale recorded in the exception itself. Commit on this branch only.
